parsed.description: Audit another Agent Skill (SKILL.md format, for Claude Code / Codex etc.) to find out what it actually does, whether it adds value over a plain agent or a few-line prompt, and whether its README/marketing claims match the implementation. Optionally runs controlled A/B/C experiments (baseline vs minimal prompt vs full skill). Use when the user asks to audit, review, evaluate or sanity-check a skill, asks "is this skill worth installing / just slop / overhyped", or gives a skill directory, SKILL.md path or GitHub URL and asks what it really does. スキルを監査して・このスキル意味ある？・READMEの宣伝は妥当？・3条件で比較して、などの依頼で使う。
parsed.name: slop-skill-auditor
